title: Handpicked Indian specialty coffee brands
description: Discover Indian specialty coffee brands through their sourcing, origins and approach to roasting.
intro: A starting selection of India-based coffee brands with interesting, documented approaches to origin, sourcing, processing or brewing. We chose them for the information they publish and the variety they bring to the list; this is not a blind tasting, a ranking, or independent certification of every coffee. Offerings, stock and prices change, so check each product’s origin, grind and ingredients before ordering.

entries.name: ARAKU Coffee
entries.description: A brand centred on coffee from Andhra Pradesh’s Araku Valley and its farming communities.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: A focused regional story: its Signature page names the growing area and producers.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Compare the brand’s different Araku profiles; whole-bean and ground options are listed.

entries.name: Black Baza Coffee
entries.description: A coffee company that describes working with smallholder growers and a focus on biodiversity-friendly cultivation.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: Its Frogmouth listing identifies producers and an origin in the Nilgiris.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Explore its grower stories and coffees; check individual labels because some blends contain chicory.

entries.name: Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters
entries.description: A roaster with coffees from multiple Indian estates, including seasonal releases.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: Its published estate and processing stories provide a way to learn where some coffees come from.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Browse named-estate coffees and the roaster’s central-washing-station project.

entries.name: BROOT Coffee
entries.description: An India-based roaster offering single-origin coffees and microlots.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: Its Ammikulavi Estate profile describes a Tamil Nadu canephora lot and its processing.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Look for estate and process information on individual lots, including robusta options.

entries.name: Caffinary
entries.description: A roaster with a range that includes single-estate coffees and blends.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: The brand describes both an Arabica–Robusta blend and limited specialty-coffee releases.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Compare individual coffees and check each listing for its origin and blend.

entries.name: Corridor Seven Coffee Roasters
entries.description: A Nagpur-based roaster whose site groups coffees by filter, espresso and milk-based brewing.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: Its catalogue makes the intended brewing style a useful starting point.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Explore the brew-oriented coffee categories and named estate partners.

entries.name: FFOX Coffee
entries.description: A Kerala coffee company that lists single-origin, specialty and South Indian filter coffees.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: Its range includes estate coffees alongside South Indian filter blends.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Check the coffee-to-chicory ratio on blends if you want pure coffee.

entries.name: Fraction 9 Coffee Roasters
entries.description: A coffee-growing family’s roaster based around its Chikmagalur estate.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: The brand publishes its farm story and also offers a broader coffee selection.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Compare its farm coffees and microlots; not every listing is necessarily from the same estate.

entries.name: Kāpikottai
entries.description: A Chennai roaster with coffees from Indian farm partners and names inspired by music.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: Its Shankarābharanam listing names the estate and describes the coffee’s processing.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Browse individual estate lots or its custom sampler, and select a grind for your brewer.

entries.name: Naivo Coffee Company
entries.description: An Indian roaster with coffees sourced from India and other countries.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: Its sourcing and roasting notes distinguish filter, espresso and omni-roast approaches.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Compare origin and roast information across Indian and international coffees.

entries.name: Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters
entries.description: An India-based specialty roaster with named-origin coffees and microlots.

facts.label: Why it is here
facts.value: The company describes direct relationships with estates and smallholders and publishes processing details.

facts.label: What to explore
facts.value: Explore microlots and origins; check each bag’s provenance because the range is not exclusively Indian-grown.

ordering.explanation: Our handpicked brands are listed alphabetically by name, not ranked by taste or review score.
